subject: Consolidated review request — adding security, infra & procurement; need new demo windows
messages:
From: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@starlighthealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo next week — additional stakeholders added

Hi Vivek / Redwood team,

Quick update from our side — leadership looped in InfoSec, Platform, and Procurement after our internal alignment this morning. They each want to attend the platform demo and have a few targeted asks (particularly InfoSec and Procurement). Because of that we need to move/expand the session so everyone can participate meaningfully.

Two asks from Starlight:
- Can we make the main demo 75–90 minutes instead of 45? We need time for a short product walkthrough and a focused procurement Q&A.
- Could we schedule a separate 30–45 minute security deep-dive with your security/infra SMEs (preferably the same week)?

High-level constraints: most stakeholders travel the week of Aug 7–11 and prefer the week-of Aug 21–25 instead. Procurement would also like any written RFI guidance in advance — I attached a draft RFI with questions (RFI_Draft.xlsx).

If you can propose 3 windows for a combined session + 2 windows for the security deep-dive, that would help us lock calendars quickly.

Thanks — really excited to get procurement and security comfortable here.

— Ava Roberts
Director of IT Strategy
Starlight Health

Attachment: RFI_Draft.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@starlighthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo next week — additional stakeholders added

Thanks for the heads up, Ava — this is totally doable and we appreciate the advance notice. Splitting into two focused blocks makes sense. Proposed approach:

1) Product + procurement Q&A (75 minutes): 45 minute product walkthrough tailored to procurement questions, followed by a 30 minute procurement/contract discussion.
2) Security deep-dive (45 minutes): technical owners from our infra/security team cover data handling, encryption, audit logs, and SOC controls.

Proposed windows (week of Aug 21–25):
- Tue Aug 22, 10:00–11:15 PT (primary)
- Wed Aug 23, 13:00–14:15 PT (backup)
- Thu Aug 24, 15:00–16:15 PT (backup 2)

Security deep-dive options:
- Mon Aug 21, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed Aug 23, 16:30–17:15 PT

Monica / Priyom — can your teams support these slots? If not, suggest alternates and we’ll surface calendar availability. Also, please review Ava’s RFI and flag any items we should prepopulate before the meeting.

Ava — we’ll also send the procurement checklist and a short MAP after we lock the dates.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
(vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@starlighthealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo next week — additional stakeholders added

Looping in a couple quick operational notes from the delivery side:

- For the 75–90 minute session we should clearly mark 15–20 minutes as an "integration & infra" block where our infra lead talks about network/topology and on-prem options. That prevents procurement from asking network-level questions mid-demo.
- I'll attach a short security-prep checklist we can send to InfoSec in advance so the deep-dive doesn't get bogged down on basics.
- Please confirm whether procurement expects a sample SOW or just pricing language — we can surface a 1-page SOW stub if helpful.

Suggested additional invitees from our side:
- Diego Fernandez (Infra SME)
- Laura Bennett (Customer Success — renewal/ops alignment)

Attachment: security-prep-checklist.pdf

Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@starlighthealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Platform Team <platform-team@starlighthealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@starlighthealth.com>, InfoSec <infosec@starlighthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo next week — additional stakeholders added

Thanks — that schedule split looks good. A few clarifications from our side:
- Starlight attendee list (tentative): Ava Roberts, Marcus Li (Procurement), Jenna Cruz (InfoSec), Omar Patel (Platform), and two director-level observers.
- Procurement would like a 1-page SOW stub and high-level pricing bands before the combined session. If you can include that in the MAP that would be ideal.
- Travel constraints: our InfoSec director is only available after 12:30 PT on Wed Aug 23 and prefers a remote-only slot. The rest of the stakeholders are flexible the week of Aug 21.

We’ll complete the RFI draft and send back marked items by Monday (Jul 24). Also sending you a signed NDA link separately — please watch for DocuSign.

On Thu, Jul 19, 2028 at 11:05 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads up, Ava — this is totally doable and we appreciate the advance notice. Splitting into two focused blocks makes sense....

— Ava

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@starlighthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Tue Aug 22 10:00–11:15 PT + Mon Aug 21 09:00–09:45 PT (security deep-dive)

Ava — locking the slots you preferred:
- Product + Procurement Q&A: Tue, Aug 22 10:00–11:15 PT (calendar invite sent)
- Security deep-dive: Mon, Aug 21 09:00–09:45 PT (calendar invite sent)

I created a short mutual action plan and uploaded a 1-page SOW stub and MAP summary to our shared HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/STH-2028-0821. Attachments: MAP_Starlight.pdf.

Diego — can you prepare a 10-minute infra topology slide and be the primary contact for the security session?

Next steps for Ava / Starlight: send final RFI and confirm attendee list so we can tailor slides.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_Starlight.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Roberts <ava.roberts@starlighthealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confirmed: Tue Aug 22 10:00–11:15 PT + Mon Aug 21 09:00–09:45 PT (security deep-dive)

Quick note — procurement will likely ask for a contract cycle estimate and an escalation SLA for incidents. I’ll draft a short note to procurement and copy legal; Vivek, do you want me to include sample SLA language in advance or hold until the combined session?

Also recommending we include an alternate host (Monica) in the calendar in case Diego has a last-minute conflict.

Priyom
Director, Solutions Strategy, Redwood Inference
